title: Strict paragraph-local qNEW and bare latest-entry return, stopped by an early unintroduced whole form
summary: One elementary new/resume source rule was manually checked against the owned77-group paragraph before building a decoder. Exact standalone okeedy precedes every qokeedy constructor, so the empty-register/fixed-name/paragraph-local conjunction fails. All meanings stay unassigned. This is a scoped retrospective construction check, not a general reference ban.

design.source: qX introduces and stores last[X]; bareX resumes only a strictly earlier such entry. No initial named entries, alternate roles or changedscope.
